marta: Heads-up: Customer Marlin sent a small LoRA patch for our `cust/marlin/` stack. After merging I noticed enumeration/bullet numbers shift (1 -> 0, bullets reordered). QA flagged it.

diego: example please?

marta: quick repro from the smoke pack:
```
Prompt: "Enumerate the onboarding steps."
Expected: "1. Authenticate
2. Connect device
3. Confirm settings"
After merge: "0. Authenticate
1. Connect device
2. Confirm settings"
```

hikaru: that screams vocab alignment issue. Did you check the LoRA metadata for tokenizer type and special token ordering?

marta: metadata: `\"tokenizer\": \"spm-unigram\"`, special order `[UNK, PAD, EOS, BOS]`. Our model uses BPE with `[BOS, EOS, PAD, UNK]`.

diego: remapping specials is usually quick. Did you run the remap tool?

marta: ran `tools/vocab_align.py --src marlin_lora/meta --dst redwood/b2` and explicitly mapped specials. Token reindex delta went from 1.1% -> 0.35%. Still seeing tail newline and list offsets on a handful of prompts.

hikaru: we should gate merges on a tokenized-sequence-diff metric. Propose: compute tokenized sequences for the smoke set before/after merge; if >0.5% fail, 0.2-0.5% open triage.

ci-runner: kicked off quick eval job id 20711 for fp16/int8/int4 comparisons: https://ci.redwood/jobs/20711/logs

marta: ran local quick eval command:
```
./bin/quick_eval --model artifacts/marlin/merged-v1 \
  --prompts evals/marlin_smoke_180.json \
  --quant fp16,int8,int4 \
  --out /tmp/marlin_eval_summary.json
```

diego: results summary: fp16 acc 0.72, int8 0.70, int4 0.61. Most regressions clustered on enumerations, dates, and short-table formatting.

hikaru: int4 kernel on our GPU genotype has an ordering-sensitive fused-op quirk; int8 looks safer. For new customer merges default to int8 until we validate int4 on that artifact.

marta: action items I will take: 1) add `check_seq_alignment.py` to onboarding pipeline as pre-merge guard; 2) auto-run special-token remap when metadata.tokenizer != model.tokenizer; 3) update onboarding doc snippet for SEs to request original tokenizer files or a token-map from the customer.

diego: also add CI threshold config for `customer_sensitive` flag so we can be stricter for customers with formatting-heavy workloads.

hikaru: +1. If post-remap token_shift stays >0.5% revert and request native tokenizer from Marlin.

marta: opening PR with remap hook + seq-check + docs. Will re-run quick eval after merge and post artifacts here. ETA: 8 hours.

diego: thanks — please @here when the follow-up eval completes. :rocket:
